INSERT INTO public.campaign_events
(
  campaign_id,
  event_type,
  message,
  metadata
)
VALUES
(
  '{{ $('Start Campaign Webhook').first().json.body.campaignId }}',
  'campaign_started',
  'Campaign automation initialized by n8n engine',
  '{{ JSON.stringify({
    sendLimit: $('Start Campaign Webhook').first().json.body.sendLimit || 100,
    batchSize: $('Start Campaign Webhook').first().json.body.batchSize || 5
  }) }}'::jsonb
);

INSERT INTO public.email_logs (campaign_id, email, status, error, created_at)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('Start Campaign Webhook').first().json.body.campaignId }}',
  '{{ $json.recipientEmail }}',
  'skipped',
  'Skipped: Duplicate email address in Google Sheet',
  NOW()
);

INSERT INTO public.campaign_events (campaign_id, event_type, email, message)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('Start Campaign Webhook').first().json.body.campaignId }}',
  'email_skipped',
  '{{ $json.recipientEmail }}',
  'Skipped duplicate lead: ' || '{{ $json.recipientEmail }}'
);

UPDATE public.campaigns 
SET sent_count = sent_count + 1, 
    pending_count = GREATEST(0, pending_count - 1),
    updated_at = NOW() 
WHERE id = '{{ $('Start Campaign Webhook').first().json.body.campaignId }}';

INSERT INTO public.email_logs (campaign_id, email, status, sent_at, created_at) 
VALUES ('{{ $('Start Campaign Webhook').first().json.body.campaignId }}', '{{ $json.recipientEmail }}', 'sent', NOW(), NOW());

UPDATE public.campaigns
SET status = 'completed',
    completed_at = NOW(),
    pending_count = 0,
    total_count = COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.email_logs WHERE campaign_id = '{{ $('Start Campaign Webhook').first().json.body.campaignId }}'), sent_count)
WHERE id = '{{ $('Start Campaign Webhook').first().json.body.campaignId }}';

INSERT INTO public.campaign_events (campaign_id, event_type, message, metadata)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('Start Campaign Webhook').first().json.body.campaignId }}',
  'campaign_completed',
  'Automation finished! All sheet leads processed and duplicates logged.',
  '{"status": "completed"}'::jsonb
);
